title: Proof of existence for quantum characteristic classes
html:
Proof. Proof of existence for quantum characteristic classes

The jet prolongation (jet prolongation) produces a central extension 1 \to \mathcal{B} \to \mathfrak{G}_{n+1} \to \mathfrak{G}_n \to 1 of gerbes banded by the sheaf of units \mathcal{B}. By Giraud's classification of gerbe extensions, every such central extension is classified by a class in H^2(\mathcal{S}, \mathcal{B}); this class is \kappa_n.

Concretely: choose local trivialisations \{U_\alpha \to \mathcal{S}\} of \mathfrak{G}_n with transition 2-cocycles \{g_{\alpha\beta\gamma}\} valued in \mathcal{B}. The obstruction to extending these transitions to \mathfrak{G}_{n+1} is the Čech cocycle \kappa_n = [\{g_{\alpha\beta\gamma}\}] \in H^2. Independence of the trivialisation choice follows because different trivialisations give cohomologous cocycles.
